name: num2cell
comment: Sig: C = num2cell(A[,dims]). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: added the dim form (was element-wise only; num2cell(A,dim) threw 'Index exceeds array size 1'). The listed dims are COLLAPSED into each cell: num2cell(A,2)=2x1 cell of rows (c{1}=[1 2 3]); num2cell(A,1)=1x3 cell of columns (c{1}=[1;4]); num2cell(A,[1 2])=1x1 cell holding the whole matrix; a dim > ndim (num2cell(A,3) on a 2-D A) is a trivial singleton -> element-wise 2x3. 2-D only (N-D deferred). namespace=builtin.
